comment: M09 golden-slice faction read. A joined player frames the loading guards, the only group placed at the start, then clears them through the ordinary route (the same states as client/qa/m09_passenger_manifest.json) so the office lesson places the first Enforcer, and posed views frame it on the wide office landing at 6 to 15 m (it may step off its post once it sees the player). Later Enforcers spawn when their encounter wakes; the combat route reaches them. Run with FRAGR_QA_BOTS=0 FRAGR_QA_SEED=42 FRAGR_QA_MAP_FILE=server/maps/m09_passenger_manifest.json. Check the Enforcer's black powered armour, red armband, visor and optics against the bone pressure shell, the gunmetal hull and the warm berth light; art review, not combat evidence.

states.name: arrival
states.note: The unforced first-person arrival frame in the lower loading lane.

states.name: loading_near
states.note: Two Clerks and a Sweeper among the cargo at 7 to 12 m.

states.name: loading_far
states.note: The loading guards down the lane at 15 to 25 m, the stair Turret to the left.

states.name: loading_equipment
states.note: Ordinary finite sidearm, shotgun, rounds and shells in the loading lane.

states.name: loading_clear
states.note: The real loading fight; it places the office lesson.

states.name: loading_arrival
states.note: From the lane, the first Enforcer on the landing above at about 9 m.

states.name: enforcer_close
states.note: The Enforcer at 6 m on the landing: powered black armour, red armband, red visor and optics.

states.name: enforcer_mid
states.note: From the office mouth at about 14 m, the open edge behind it.

states.name: enforcer_above
states.note: From the end of the hatch bridge at about 15 m, looking down on the landing.
